## What changed

- Removed the temporary device-configuration migration notice from the top of the README now that the v0.5 device-based workflow is the normal supported setup.
- Kept the permanent documentation explaining that SaltWatch Card uses Home Assistant's device and entity registries.

## Card behavior

There are no rendering, configuration, localization, layout, or entity-resolution changes in this patch. SaltWatch Card continues to require an official SaltWatch device running firmware v2.0.0 or newer.

## Validation

- All 48 unit tests passed.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
- The published JavaScript asset is generated and checked by the release workflow.
